PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.2 — Ore search and deposit guidance with resizable HUD.
PluginData.Description: Learned ore search, configurable pings, optional SDX2 scan estimates and approximate nearby deposit guidance. Resize the list HUD from its edges and corners; text follows panel height. Quantities are estimates. Search starts off each launch. Includes automatic overlay shutdown. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
